gates.intermediate_tradeoffs: TVP3 vs TVP2: page/line first-band p95 +22.0/+25.5 ms; Panel raise/action p95 +105.1 ms. Gesture-only p95 improves 75.0 ms. These exceed the frozen tolerance and are not characterized as noise.
gates.cancellation: Escape/Stop/physical BREAK functional checks pass. CAT retirement was longer in the final short replay (1015.3 vs 282.4 ms), but BREAK follows variable-duration Panel completion, so stream progress at cancellation differs. This is not a controlled cancellation-latency comparison; that gate remains unqualified.
